annotations.title: Get a private link for a client

description: For agencies and freelancers posting for clients: one brand per client. Creates a private page for one brand, good for 30 days, that the client opens without a PostWire account to connect that brand's own social accounts (each network is signed in on its own page, so no password is shared with the agency), approve or ask for changes on the brand's posts waiting for approval (Pro and above; on Starter the client only sees them), see what is scheduled for the next 14 days and read last month's report. Give brand_id, or brand_name: an existing brand with that name is used, otherwise a new brand is created (the plan's brand limit applies). A brand has at most 3 active client links; past that the newest active one is returned (reused: true). Client links come with every paid plan; on Free nothing is created and the response names the plan that includes them, its monthly price and a checkout link. Returns url, expires_at, the brand, message_for_user (one plain sentence for the person) and send_to_client (a sentence to send the client together with the link). Anyone with the link can use it, so it goes only to the client; it can be turned off from the PostWire dashboard.

brand_id.description: The client's brand. Omit it and give brand_name to use or create a brand by name.

brand_name.description: The client's business name: the brand with this name, or a new brand if there is none.
